def f5(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    single={}; allruns={}
    for i in range(H):
        rr=[(a,b,e) for (a,b,e) in runs(g[i]) if a!=bg]

            allruns[i]=rr[-1][2]

    L=max(e-b for a,b,e in single.values())

    for i,(a,b,e) in single.items():
        target=b+L
        for j in range(e,min(target,W)):
            if g[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=1
